title_en: Why do you torment me, cursed fate
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear: sounds like a modern composed song about childlessness, but I cannot name an author. Line 'чедото мое ми го одзема' is read as fate keeping a child from her, my reading.

lines.en: Why do you torment me, cursed fate,
my fate, may you be damned,
my child you take from me,
why, fate, did you curse me so badly,
my child you take from me,
why, fate, did you curse me so badly?

lines.cyr: Зар јас не можам чедо да гледам,
lines.lat: Zar jas ne možam čedo da gledam,
lines.en: Am I not able to see my child,

lines.cyr: со злато и свила да го облечам,
lines.lat: so zlato i svila da go oblečam,
lines.en: to dress it in gold and silk,
tell me, tell me, cursed fate,
why, fate, did you curse me so badly,
tell me, tell me, cursed fate,

lines.cyr: што сум ти судбо толку згрешила?
lines.lat: što sum ti sudbo tolku zgrešila?
lines.en: what did I do wrong to you, fate, so much?

lines.cyr: Секој ми вели да сум најсреќна,
lines.lat: Sekoj mi veli da sum najsreḱna,
lines.en: Everyone tells me I am the happiest,
no one knows my pain,
my pain cannot be healed,

lines.cyr: чедо со пари не се купува,
lines.lat: čedo so pari ne se kupuva,
lines.en: a child cannot be bought with money,
my pain cannot be healed,

lines.cyr: рожба со пари не се купува.
lines.lat: rožba so pari ne se kupuva.
lines.en: a birth cannot be bought with money.
Nothing can, cursed fate,
cheer my aching heart,
only with songs do I forget the pain,
song heals my wounds,
only with songs do I forget the pain,
song heals my wounds.
